title: HULK Smash: Brucie's Bills Crush Lifts No Banner only HULK to 55% Title Odds
dek: Josh Allen drops 40 for the league's favorite villain-in-waiting, Sonny posts the week's top score with Mahomes on his bench, and Habib reshuffles his waiver wire into a perfect circle.
body: The man who wasn't sure he even wanted to be in this league is now running away with it. Ramon's No Banner only HULK flattened Zoe's Ghostu-Spider SZN 131.92 to 82.8, moving to 2-0 with a league-best 309.8 points for. His title odds jumped from 49% to 55%, which means the rest of the league now has slightly worse than a coin flip at keeping Brucie away from Buckaroo Bowl IV. Somewhere, seven managers are quietly hoping he loses a video game this week and takes it out on his lineup.

The engine was Josh Allen, who put up 40.82 points against a 22.65 projection, the top performance of the week. Yes, the Chicago-born Bills convert got bailed out by his adopted team's quarterback, and no, the rest of the league will not be letting that go. The scariest part is what Brucie left on his bench: Matthew Stafford (26.98) and Travis Kelce (20.6) both sat out. He won by 49 points while leaving nearly 48 more on the pine, which is less of a blunder and more of a warning shot.

Commissioner Sonny posted the highest score of the week, as The Horse is Hea trampled Jordan's Counting or not Counting GV 142.46 to 82.08. Jaxon Smith-Njigba torched his 15.22 projection for 38 points, which made it easy to forget that Patrick Mahomes scored 28.98 on Sonny's bench. Benching a Mahomes 29-burger and still winning by 60 is either Boston-level arrogance or a commissioner who knows something we don't. Sonny's title odds more than tripled from 3% to 10%, and the worst-to-first defending champ is 2-0 again. JMoney, meanwhile, got 0.6 points out of Malik Nabers against a 12.26 projection, a number even a numbers guy can't spin.

Philliberto got his first win, and the villain winning is as satisfying for him as it is painful for everyone else. Team Pillbert beat Habibsters 135.48 to 109.66 behind Davante Adams, who erupted for 35.5 against a 13.14 projection. Kaushal can't buy a break: CeeDee Lamb (31.3) and Dak Prescott (29.76) both crushed their projections, he got a Cowboys stack firing on all cylinders, and he still lost by 26. Alan's title odds tripled from 4% to 12%, which puts the 1-1 bad guy ahead of 2-0 Sonny in the eyes of the model, and you just know Philly is going to bring that up.

Randy's The fumblers stayed perfect, upsetting Mekhi's Dawgs 124.02 to 100.74 despite the Dawgs being 70% pregame favorites. Amon-Ra St. Brown carried the load with 30.7 points, because Caleb Williams certainly didn't: the Bears QB managed 7.72 against a 19.42 projection. Randy is 2-0 with 270.2 points for, yet his title odds slid from 28% to 20%, so expect him to complain about winning, and then not trade anyone to fix it. Kai, the league's best football mind, is 0-2 and down to 8% playoff odds, which continues his proud tradition of the universe not cooperating with him.

On the waiver wire, Habib put on a clinic in going nowhere fast. He grabbed the Buccaneers D/ST for the Jaguars D/ST, swapped the Bucs for the 49ers D/ST, flipped Wan'Dale Robinson for Deebo Samuel Sr., then reversed both moves to end the week holding the Bucs and Wan'Dale. That's five transactions to change one defense, the kind of high-speed loop the Georgia State Patrol would recognize. Elsewhere, Alan dropped Tony Pollard for Jalen Coker and Sam LaPorta for Isaiah Likely, Zilgit added Devaughn Vele without dropping anyone, and Mekhi swapped Carnell Tate for Kenyon Sadiq.

The standings after two weeks: HULK, The fumblers and The Horse is Hea sit at 2-0, with Team Pillbert and Ghostu-Spider SZN at 1-1 and Habibsters, Dawgs and Counting or not Counting GV at 0-2. Zoe's rookie season hit its first speed bump, with Saquon Barkley delivering just 2.5 points against a 16.38 projection and her title odds dropping from 12% to 1%. JMoney's 158 points for is the league's lowest by 41, and his playoff odds sit at 1%.

Next week brings plenty of drama. Zoe's Ghostu-Spider SZN faces Randy's The fumblers in a Packers-vs-Bears grudge match, with Wisconsin's lone representative looking to make the Bears guy's Bears quarterback problem even worse. Habib gets the unenviable job of trying to stop Brucie, Sonny's The Horse is Hea hosts Kai's desperate Dawgs, and JMoney tries to dig out of the basement against Philly, which means one of the league's two 0-2 or 1-1 hopefuls is about to have a very long Monday.
